channels.agency: South Carolina Department of Environmental Services
channels.name: SC DES (sewer overflow reports under 48-1-95(B))
channels.legal_basis: S.C. Code 48-1-95(B): "Utilities must verbally notify the department of any significant spill within twenty-four hours", in writing within five days
channels.note: Utilities report overflows to DES (significant spills by telephone within 24 hours and in writing within five days), electronically through ePermitting, and DES publishes the completed reports in its ePermitting list 'View Wastewater Overflows', linked from its overflow page: start, end, receipt, permit, site, manhole or pump station, receiving water, volume and cause, 1,773 reports from September 2022 on 2026-11-16. Every report on the list was marked completed; DES received a report a median of 4.9 days after the overflow began. The list gives no coordinates. Read hourly by the feed sc-des-overflow-list.

channels.agency: South Carolina Department of Environmental Services

The layer itself is read as a feed.
